{{Quote|Ice cream here...sold by the scoop.|An [[The Ice Cream Man|ice cream man]]|<ref name="SWG:FonatF">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other|Quest: "Find out more about the Fryer"}}</ref>}}
'''Corellian Fried Ice Cream''' was a type of fried [[Ice cream/Legends|ice cream]] native to [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. It was made in [[Corellian Fried Ice Cream Fryer]]s. An ice cream [[Gender/Legends|man]] on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] was known to sell it. It could also have a berry topping.<ref name="swg">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=item|Corellian Fried Ice Cream (chef schematic)}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Corellian Fried Ice Cream was actually two distinct items in [[Star Wars Galaxies]]. The first Corellian Fried Ice Cream was a chef-created food item. Its appearance was the same as [[Tranna nougat cream]]. Like a few other foods and drinks, the schematic for Corellian Fried Ice Cream was removed after Publish 6. After the Corellian Fried Ice Cream Fryer and its creation were introduced<ref name="swg 2">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=item|Corellian Fried Ice Cream}}</ref>, the original Corellian Fried Ice Cream remained distinct in game with its original appearance intact.<ref name="swg">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=item|Corellian Fried Ice Cream (chef schematic)}}</ref>
